authorship.note: All reverse engineering, waveform measurement, protocol implementation and triage were done by an AI agent; the owner performed wiring, multimeter readings and power cycling.

state.root_cause: /etc/ld.so.preload points at a crashing shared object; glibc 2.11.2 treats preload failure as fatal, so every execve fails and init never starts
state.symptom: reboot loop every ~2.66 s; no UI; USB enumerates only 054C:0994
fix_actions: make /etc/ld.so.preload empty (nflasha10, partition offset 0x0AC00000, 12 MiB vfat)
OR create /setting/sen/smode containing 'UU' (nflasha2, offset 0x00800000) to force the USB service interface from the initramfs

boot_timing_measured.method: RK3588 as USB host, dmesg timestamps
boot_timing_measured.settled_state: pure charging, SoC no longer boots; OFF->ON restarts cycling

wiring_verified.A6: 470 ohm to XRESET_REQ, low level 0.165 V

excluded_channels: BootROM serial injection via A7/A6 (correct waveform, zero response, no 0x100D)
Loader UART (ldr_drv.bin uses GPIO2 peripherals 0xF2910000 / 0xF2912000, not USB-C)
userland shell / service mode / mass storage / WiFi / Bluetooth
ADJUST / BIS forced boot modes (set by Loader via Backup_read; dead variables in initramfs)
SD-card updater / MS Boot (real 371 MB BODYDATA.DAT, behaviour unchanged)
USB 054C:0994 (single IN interrupt endpoint, no output or feature reports)
HDMI CEC / hot shoe / mic / headphone
direct eMMC access / JTAG (BGA, requires soldering)
open_question: What physical access makes the ZV-E10 gen 1 accept a write (BootROM serial entry, boot-mode strap, or a loader write path)?
help_needed: ZV-E10 SY-1121 boardview / test point photos (BOOT_SERIAL_IN = BGA G18/L19; straps N8/P4/AL24; XRESET_REQ = L11)
the exact physical connection used in documented successful runs
a definitive answer whether ZV-E10 gen 1 supports BootROM serial boot
any non-destructive way to write 1-2 bytes to nflasha2 or nflasha10
constraints: owner's only camera; no disassembly, no repair shop, no soldering
no Sony firmware, BootROM dumps or keys in this repository
